data.one_liner: Flutter implementation of Simple 3D Format for non-experts and scientific applications
data.what_it_does: Provides a Dart implementation of the Simple 3D Format (.sp3d) to handle 3D objects, vertices, materials, and simple physics. It allows creation, manipulation, conversion, and loading of 3D data primarily designed for science and simple games.
use_when: You are building scientific or physical calculation apps that require simple 3D object handling.
You want to store or read 3D objects in a single editable text file format (.sp3d).
avoid_when: You require advanced graphics rendering, complex shaders, or high-performance gaming features.
You need robust compatibility with standard 3D formats like OBJ or FBX without external conversion packages.
strengths: Simple and lightweight structure designed for readability in text editors.
Built-in support for serialization/deserialization to and from dictionary maps (JSON).
Includes basic vertex manipulation, transformation, and physical calculation helper classes.
weaknesses: Not suitable for advanced graphics or complex 3D scenes.
Minimal compatibility with other standard 3D formats.

alternatives.name: three_js
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you need a more full-featured 3D library ported from Three.js instead of a custom simple format.

data.minimal_example:
final sp3dObj = Sp3dObj(
    [Sp3dV3D(0, 0, 0)],
    [
      Sp3dFragment(
          [
            Sp3dFace([0], 0)
          ],
          isParticle: true,
          r: 1)
    ],
    [
      Sp3dMaterial(
        Color.fromARGB(255, 0, 255, 0),
        true,
        1,
        Color.fromARGB(255, 0, 255, 0),
      )
    ],
    []);
